messages:
jen: Heads up — getting reports that pages from incident-broker aren't reaching oncall. Customers seeing delayed ACKs. Anyone else?

opsbot: incident-broker detected multiple failed deliveries to escalation-policy 'core-sre' (5m window). Auto-retry suspended. See /incidents/1973123456 for details.

sam: confirmed — my phone didn't ring. channel got a few >spam-like< bursts to infra-team while core-sre got nothing. looks like routing table flip during the deploy at 12:03 UTC.

lucas: I rolled the orchestrator update 12:02. There's a new header key we read for policy mapping (X-esc-policy) — might be blanked by the gateway under load.

emily: customer impact: 3 mid-tier customers reported delayed incident response, one escalated to support call. SLA breach risk.

jen: ops, can we trigger the safe fallback? fallback should send to sms-relay and escalate via paging-bridge.

oncall-sre: I don't see any incoming pages in the logs. Can you dump the last 30s of the broker queue?

sam: grabbing queue dump now — snippet:
```
$ curl -s https://int-broker/internal/queue?limit=50 
[...]
id: 9a3f -> dest: core-sre -> headers: {"X-esc-policy": ""} -> state: quiesced
id: 9a40 -> dest: infra -> headers: {"X-esc-policy": "infra"} -> state: delivered
```

lucas: yep header missing for core-sre entries. gateway change merged yesterday strips unknown headers when proxy pool reaches 80% cpu. nasty.

jen: mitigation plan: 1) Enable broker fallback to sms-relay (manual flag). 2) Roll the gateway proxy with header passthrough fix. 3) Requeue quiesced items. 4) Notify customers and SRE lead.

emily: I'll message affected customers with ETA and note manual escalation path.

oncall-sre: (on phone) Flip the fallback now please. I can accept SMS pages.

sam: flipping fallback flag: `./admin toggle-fallback --service=incident-broker --to=sms-relay`
opsbot: fallback enabled for incident-broker; future deliveries will be routed to sms-relay.

jen: good. sam — requeue the quiesced batch with a strict header override while we patch.

sam: requeue command run:
```
$ ./admin requeue --ids=9a3f,9a42,9a47 --set-header 'X-esc-policy: core-sre' --dry-run
-->> 3 messages would be requeued
$ ./admin requeue --ids=9a3f,9a42,9a47 --set-header 'X-esc-policy: core-sre'
-->> 3 messages requeued -> sms-relay delivery started
```

oncall-sre: Received SMS for ticket INC-4123, ACKed. ringdown successful.

lucas: starting hotfix rollout for gateway now — reverting the strip behavior and adding a whitelist for safe headers. Patch PR: https://git.internal/rw/gateway/pull/2203

jen: parallel tasks: lucas deploys, sam watches queue, emily drafts customer note. I'll coordinate handoff after the fix.

opsbot: gateway deployment started by lucas; build 2203 -> canary -> 3 nodes.

sam: queue draining, delivery success rate back to normal for SMS path. No more quiesced items.

oncall-sre: can confirm pages back to normal, infra oncall got a page (weird duplicate) but manual ACKs in place.

emily: customer updates sent to 3 affected accounts. One asked for a postmortem.

lucas: gateway canary passed. rolling to remainder. patch includes safer header parse and an integration test for header-preserve.

jen: once rollout completes, we should flip fallback off and let broker resume normal routing. Also create follow-up items: add alert for header-drop rates, update deploy playbook to include header-compat check, and schedule postmortem.

oncall-sre: agreed. I'm taking the incident for the PM. steps logged.

opsbot: fallback disabled for incident-broker. normal routing resumed.

jen: incident resolved for now. timeline: root cause - gateway header-strip under high cpu after recent proxy change; impact - missed pages to core-sre and customer-visible delay; mitigation - enabled SMS fallback, requeued messages, rolled gateway fix.

emily: filing customer impact report and tagging for postmortem.

sam: notes pushed to runbook: `/runbooks/paging-integration/incident-broker-header-drop.md`

jen: thanks all — we'll sync in retro. :white_check_mark:
